title: pithecellobium coccineum
intro: Pithecellobium coccineum, commonly known as the Coral Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family, Fabaceae. The Coral Tree is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pithecellobium coccineum include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent, making it useful in treating wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
